label: TP
reason: User input flows directly from getParameterNames() through doSomething() to response.getWriter().printf() without any sanitization or encoding. The X-XSS-Protection header is disabled ('0'), providing no mitigation. The printf format string outputs user-controlled content (%1$s) directly to the response stream enabling XSS.

evidence.note: User input captured via getParameterNames(), stored in param, passed through doSomething() unchanged, then written to response.getWriter().printf() without sanitization
response.getHeader("X-XSS-Protection", "0") disables browser-based XSS protection, confirming vulnerability
